      "content": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Date, DateTime, ForeignKey, CheckConstraint, UniqueConstraint\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import relationship\nfrom database import Base\n\nclass User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    full_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    role = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"role IN ('admin','reviewer','coordinator')\")\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Program(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"programs\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    name = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    department = Column(String)\n    degree_type = Column(String, check_constraint=\"degree_type IN ('BS','BA','MS','PhD')\")\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Intake(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"intakes\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    term = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"term IN ('Fall','Spring','Summer')\")\n    year = Column(Integer, nullable=False)\n    level = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"level IN ('Undergraduate','Graduate')\")\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    __table_args__ = (UniqueConstraint('term', 'year', 'level'),)\n\n\nclass Application(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"applications\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    applicant_name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    applicant_email = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    program_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"programs.id\"), nullable=False)\n    intake_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"intakes.id\"), nullable=False)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"submitted\", check_constraint=\"status IN ('submitted','under_review','reviewed','decision_made','withdrawn')\")\n    assigned_reviewer_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=True)\n    review_deadline = Column(Date)\n    financial_aid_documents_complete = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0, check_constraint=\"financial_aid_documents_complete IN (0,1)\")\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    # Relationships\n    program = relationship(\"Program\")\n    intake = relationship(\"Intake\")\n    reviewer = relationship(\"User\", foreign_keys=[assigned_reviewer_id])\n\n\nclass Rubric(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"rubrics\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    version = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    description = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    __table_args__ = (UniqueConstraint('name', 'version'),)\n\n\nclass ApplicationRubric(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"application_rubrics\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    application_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"applications.id\"), nullable=False)\n    rubric_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"rubrics.id\"), nullable=False)\n    attached_by = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    attached_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    # Relationships\n    application = relationship(\"Application\")\n    rubric = relationship(\"Rubric\")\n    attached_by_user = relationship(\"User\", foreign_keys=[attached_by])\n\n\nclass CommentThread(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"comment_threads\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    application_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"applications.id\"), nullable=False)\n    created_by = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    # Relationships\n    application = relationship(\"Application\")\n    creator = relationship(\"User\", foreign_keys=[created_by])\n\n\nclass Comment(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"comments\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    thread_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"comment_threads.id\"), nullable=False)\n    author_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    body = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    # Relationships\n    thread = relationship(\"CommentThread\")\n    author = relationship(\"User\")\n\n\nclass AuditLog(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"audit_log\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    action = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    entity_type = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    entity_id = Column(Integer)\n    details = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    # Relationships\n    user = relationship(\"User\")"

      "path": "schemas.py",
      "content": "from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict\nfrom typing import Optional, List\nfrom datetime import date\n\nclass ApplicationBulkAssignRequest(BaseModel):\n    program_name: str\n    intake_term: str\n    intake_year: int\n    intake_level: str\n    reviewer_email: str\n    rubric_name: str\n    rubric_version: str\n    review_deadline: date\n    comment_note: str\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)\n\nclass ApplicationBulkAssignResponse(BaseModel):\n    assigned_count: int\n    failed_assignments: List[dict]\n\n    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)"
    },
    {
      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom datetime import date\nfrom typing import List, Dict\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Application, User, Program, Intake, Rubric, ApplicationRubric, CommentThread, Comment\nfrom schemas import ApplicationBulkAssignRequest, ApplicationBulkAssignResponse\n\nrouter = APIRouter(\n    prefix=\"/api/applications\",\n    tags=[\"Applications\"]\n)\n\n@router.post(\"/bulk_assign\", operation_id=\"bulk_assign_applications\")\nasync def bulk_assign_applications(\n    payload: ApplicationBulkAssignRequest,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    # Find the reviewer by email\n    reviewer = db.query(User).filter(User.email == payload.reviewer_email).first()\n    if not reviewer:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Reviewer not found\")\n\n    # Find the program\n    program = db.query(Program).filter(Program.name == payload.program_name).first()\n    if not program:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Program not found\")\n\n    # Find the intake\n    intake = db.query(Intake).filter(\n        Intake.term == payload.intake_term,\n        Intake.year == payload.intake_year,\n        Intake.level == payload.intake_level\n    ).first()\n    if not intake:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Intake not found\")\n\n    # Find the rubric\n    rubric = db.query(Rubric).filter(\n        Rubric.name == payload.rubric_name,\n        Rubric.version == payload.rubric_version\n    ).first()\n    if not rubric:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Rubric not found\")\n\n    # Find all unassigned applications in the specified program and intake with status 'submitted'\n    applications = db.query(Application).filter(\n        Application.program_id == program.id,\n        Application.intake_id == intake.id,\n        Application.status == \"submitted\",\n        Application.assigned_reviewer_id.is_(None)\n    ).all()\n\n    assigned_count = 0\n    failed_assignments = []\n\n    for app in applications:\n        try:\n            # Update application\n            app.assigned_reviewer_id = reviewer.id\n            app.review_deadline = payload.review_deadline\n            app.updated_at = datetime.utcnow()\n\n            # Create ApplicationRubric entry\n            app_rubric = ApplicationRubric(\n                application_id=app.id,\n                rubric_id=rubric.id,\n                attached_by=reviewer.id\n            )\n            db.add(app_rubric)\n\n            # Create CommentThread\n            comment_thread = CommentThread(\n                application_id=app.id,\n                created_by=reviewer.id\n            )\n            db.add(comment_thread)\n            db.flush()  # Ensure thread has an ID\n\n            # Create Comment\n            comment = Comment(\n                thread_id=comment_thread.id,\n                author_id=reviewer.id,\n                body=payload.comment_note\n            )\n            db.add(comment)\n\n            assigned_count += 1\n\n        except Exception as e:\n            failed_assignments.append({\n                \"application_id\": app.id,\n                \"reason\": str(e)\n            })\n\n    try:\n        db.commit()\n    except Exception as e:\n        db.rollback()\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f\"Failed to commit changes: {str(e)}\")\n\n    return ApplicationBulkAssignResponse(\n        assigned_count=assigned_count,\n        failed_assignments=failed_assignments\n    )"
    }
  ]
